Alias.name: gbrandish
Alias.script: if GBRANDISH and GBRANDISH.command then GBRANDISH.command(matches[2] or "") else cecho("<red>[GBrandish] Startup failed; reinstall the current GBrandish.xml package.<reset>\n") end

Alias.name: gbr
Alias.script: if GBRANDISH and GBRANDISH.command then GBRANDISH.command(matches[2] or "") else cecho("<red>[GBrandish] Startup failed; reinstall the current GBrandish.xml package.<reset>\n") end

Script.name: GBrandish
Script.script:
---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- -- GBrandish -- Automatic, charge-safe stave use backed by the DINV v3 controlled API. ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
GBRANDISH = GBRANDISH or {} local gbr = GBRANDISH
gbr.version = "1.0.1" gbr.config = gbr.config or { enabled = false, selector = "breath", aoe = 2, interval = 3.0, chargeFloor = 1, resultTimeout = 5.0, roomMaxAge = 5.0, } gbr.runtime = gbr.runtime or {} gbr.triggers = gbr.triggers or {} gbr.aliases = gbr.aliases or {} gbr.handlers = gbr.handlers or {} gbr.timers = gbr.timers or {}
local function trim(value) return tostring(value or ""):gsub("^%s+", ""):gsub("%s+$", "") end
local function stripColors(value) local text = tostring(value or "") if type(ansi2decho) == "function" then -- Aardwolf @-codes are the only ones DINV names normally contain; -- leave ANSI handling to Mudlet and remove those stable codes here. end return text:gsub("@.", ""):gsub("<[^>]+>", "") end
local function normalized(value) return trim(stripColors(value):gsub("%s+", " ")):lower() end
local function truthy(value) return value == true or value == 1 or tostring(value):lower() == "true" end
local function number(value, fallback) local parsed = tonumber(value) if parsed == nil then return fallback end return parsed end
function gbr.print(message, color) color = color or "cyan" if type(cecho) == "function" then cecho(string.format("<%s>[GBrandish]<reset> %s\n", color, tostring(message or ""))) else print("[GBrandish] " .. tostring(message or "")) end end
function gbr.debug(message) if gbr.config.debug == true then gbr.print(message, "dim_grey") end end
local function killTimerField(name) local id = gbr.timers[name] if id and type(killTimer) == "function" then pcall(killTimer, id) end gbr.timers[name] = nil end
local function after(seconds, name, callback) killTimerField(name) if type(tempTimer) ~= "function" then callback() return nil end gbr.timers[name] = tempTimer(seconds, function() gbr.timers[name] = nil callback() end) return gbr.timers[name] end
local function sendCommand(command) if type(send) == "function" then send(command, false) return true end return false end
function gbr.settingsPath() local home = type(getMudletHomeDir) == "function" and getMudletHomeDir() or "." return home .. "/GBrandish/settings.lua" end
function gbr.saveSettings() local file = io.open(gbr.settingsPath(), "w") if not file then return false end file:write("return {\n") file:write(" enabled = ", tostring(gbr.config.enabled == true), ",\n") file:write(" selector = ", string.format("%q", tostring(gbr.config.selector or "")), ",\n") file:write(" aoe = ", tostring(math.floor(number(gbr.config.aoe, 2))), ",\n") file:write(" interval = ", tostring(number(gbr.config.interval, 3)), ",\n") file:write("}\n") file:close() return true end
function gbr.loadSettings() local chunk = loadfile(gbr.settingsPath()) if not chunk then return false end local ok, saved = pcall(chunk) if not ok or type(saved) ~= "table" then return false end if saved.enabled ~= nil then gbr.config.enabled = saved.enabled == true end if trim(saved.selector) ~= "" then gbr.config.selector = trim(saved.selector) end gbr.config.aoe = math.max(1, math.floor(number(saved.aoe, gbr.config.aoe))) gbr.config.interval = math.max(0.5, number(saved.interval, gbr.config.interval)) return true end
function gbr.dinvReady() return DINV and DINV.api and DINV.actions and number(DINV.api.version, 0) >= 3 and type(DINV.api.getStaves) == "function" and type(DINV.actions.reserveStaveUse) == "function" end
local function currentRoomId() local candidates = { gmcp and gmcp.room and gmcp.room.info and gmcp.room.info.num, gmcp and gmcp.room and gmcp.room.info and gmcp.room.info.id, gmcp and gmcp.Room and gmcp.Room.Info and gmcp.Room.Info.num, gmcp and gmcp.Room and gmcp.Room.Info and gmcp.Room.Info.id, } for _, value in ipairs(candidates) do if value ~= nil and tostring(value) ~= "" then return tostring(value) end end return "" end
local function combatState() local state = gmcp and gmcp.char and gmcp.char.status and gmcp.char.status.state if state == nil and gmcp and gmcp.Char and gmcp.Char.Status then state = gmcp.Char.Status.state end return tostring(state or "") end
function gbr.inCombat() return combatState() == "8" end
local function itemName(item) return trim(item and (item.name or item.colorName or item.colorname) or "") end
local function itemMatchesSelector(item) local needle = normalized(gbr.config.selector) if needle == "" then return false end local fields = { item and item.name, item and item.colorName, item and item.colorname, item and item.keywords, } for _, value in ipairs(fields) do if normalized(value):find(needle, 1, true) then return true end end return false end
local function chargeState(item) local known = truthy(item and (item.chargeKnown ~= nil and item.chargeKnown or item.chargeknown)) local dirty = truthy(item and (item.chargeDirty ~= nil and item.chargeDirty or item.chargedirty)) local charges = known and tonumber(item and item.charges) or nil return known, dirty, charges and math.max(0, math.floor(charges)) or nil end
local function itemIsKept(item) return truthy(item and item.keepflag) end
local function itemIsHeld(item) if not item then return false end local worn = normalized(item.worn) local location = normalized(item.location) return worn == "hold" or location == "hold" or (item.isWorn == true and normalized(item.wearable) == "hold") end
function gbr.getStaves(applySelector) if not gbr.dinvReady() then return nil, "DINV API v3 is not ready." end local result = DINV.api.getStaves({ detail = "full", source = "live" }) if not result or not result.ok then return nil, result and (result.message or result.code) or "DINV getStaves failed." end local staves = {} for _, item in ipairs(result.items or {}) do if applySelector ~= true or itemMatchesSelector(item) then table.insert(staves, item) end end return staves end
local function sortUsable(left, right) local _, _, leftCharges = chargeState(left) local _, _, rightCharges = chargeState(right) leftCharges, rightCharges = leftCharges or math.huge, rightCharges or math.huge if leftCharges ~= rightCharges then return leftCharges < rightCharges end return tostring(left.id) < tostring(right.id) end
function gbr.findUsableStaves(excludeId) local staves, err = gbr.getStaves(true) if not staves then return nil, err end local usable = {} for _, item in ipairs(staves) do local known, dirty, charges = chargeState(item) if tostring(item.id) ~= tostring(excludeId or "") and known and not dirty and charges and charges > gbr.config.chargeFloor then table.insert(usable, item) end end table.sort(usable, sortUsable) return usable end
function gbr.currentStave() local staves = gbr.getStaves(true) if not staves then return nil end for _, item in ipairs(staves) do if itemIsHeld(item) then return item end end if gbr.runtime.activeId then for _, item in ipairs(staves) do if tostring(item.id) == tostring(gbr.runtime.activeId) then return item end end end return nil end
function gbr.equipStave(item, callback) callback = callback or function() end if not item or not item.id then callback(false, "No stave selected."); return end if not gbr.dinvReady() then callback(false, "DINV API v3 is not ready."); return end if gbr.runtime.switching then callback(false, "A stave switch is already pending."); return end
if itemIsHeld(item) then gbr.runtime.activeId = tostring(item.id) callback(true) return end
gbr.runtime.switching = true local finished = false local function finish(ok, message) if finished then return end finished = true gbr.runtime.switching = false if ok then gbr.runtime.activeId = tostring(item.id) end callback(ok, message) end
local result = DINV.actions.hold(item.id, { label = "GBrandish switch", report = false, onFinish = function(operation) finish(operation and #(operation.failures or {}) == 0, operation and #(operation.failures or {}) > 0 and "DINV did not confirm the stave switch." or nil) end, }) if not result or not result.ok then finish(false, result and (result.message or result.code) or "DINV hold failed.") elseif number(result.commandCount, 0) == 0 then finish(true) end end
local function groupMembersHere() local raw = gmcp and (gmcp.group or gmcp.Group) local names = {} if type(raw) ~= "table" or type(raw.members) ~= "table" then return names, false end for _, member in ipairs(raw.members) do local info = type(member) == "table" and member.info or nil local here = info and (info.here == true or number(info.here, 0) == 1) if here and trim(member.name) ~= "" then names[normalized(member.name)] = true end end return names, true end
local function parseRoomcharLine(line) local remaining = trim(stripColors(line)) if remaining == "" or remaining == "{roomchars}" or remaining == "{/roomchars}" then return nil end local isPlayer = false while remaining ~= "" do local flag, rest = remaining:match("^(%b())%s*(.*)$") if not flag then flag, rest = remaining:match("^(%b[])%s*(.*)$") end if not flag then break end local value = normalized(flag:gsub("^.", ""):gsub(".$", "")) if value == "p" or value == "player" then isPlayer = true end remaining = trim(rest) end return { player = isPlayer, name = remaining, raw = trim(line) } end
function gbr.roomcharsStart() gbr.runtime.roomCapture = { roomId = currentRoomId(), npcCount = 0, players = {}, rows = 0, } end
function gbr.roomcharsLine(line) local capture = gbr.runtime.roomCapture if not capture then return end local row = parseRoomcharLine(line) if not row then return end capture.rows = capture.rows + 1 if row.player then table.insert(capture.players, row.name) else capture.npcCount = capture.npcCount + 1 end end
function gbr.roomSafety(snapshot) snapshot = snapshot or gbr.runtime.roomSnapshot if not snapshot then return false, { "room population is unknown" } end if #(snapshot.players or {}) == 0 then return true, {} end local members, available = groupMembersHere() if not available then return false, { "group GMCP is unavailable" } end local unsafe = {} for _, name in ipairs(snapshot.players or {}) do if not members[normalized(name)] then table.insert(unsafe, name) end end return #unsafe == 0, unsafe end
function gbr.roomcharsEnd() local capture = gbr.runtime.roomCapture gbr.runtime.roomCapture = nil if not capture then return end capture.roomId = currentRoomId() capture.at = os.time() gbr.runtime.roomSnapshot = capture gbr.runtime.roomDirty = false gbr.runtime.lookInFlight = false killTimerField("lookTimeout")
if gbr.runtime.manualQueued then gbr.runtime.manualQueued = false after(0.05, "tick", function() gbr.attemptBrandish(true) end) elseif gbr.config.enabled and gbr.inCombat() then after(0.05, "tick", function() gbr.attemptBrandish(false) end) end end
function gbr.invalidateRoom(reason) gbr.runtime.roomDirty = true gbr.runtime.roomDirtyReason = reason or "room changed" end
function gbr.roomSnapshotReady() local snapshot = gbr.runtime.roomSnapshot if not snapshot or gbr.runtime.roomDirty then return false end local roomId = currentRoomId() if roomId ~= "" and tostring(snapshot.roomId or "") ~= roomId then return false end if os.time() - number(snapshot.at, 0) > gbr.config.roomMaxAge then return false end return true end
function gbr.requestRoomSnapshot(manual) if manual then gbr.runtime.manualQueued = true end if gbr.runtime.lookInFlight then return end gbr.runtime.lookInFlight = true if not sendCommand("look") then gbr.runtime.lookInFlight = false return end after(2.5, "lookTimeout", function() if not gbr.runtime.lookInFlight then return end gbr.runtime.lookInFlight = false gbr.invalidateRoom("roomchars timeout") if manual then gbr.runtime.manualQueued = false gbr.print("No roomchars snapshot arrived after look; brandish was not sent.", "red") end end) end
function gbr.scheduleAuto(delay) if not gbr.config.enabled or not gbr.inCombat() then return end after(delay or gbr.config.interval, "tick", function() gbr.attemptBrandish(false) end) end
function gbr.handleMissingResult() local pending = gbr.runtime.pendingUse if not pending then return end gbr.runtime.pendingUse = nil local result = DINV.actions.cancelStaveUse(pending.id, pending.token, { markUnknown = true, source = "brandish-result-timeout", }) gbr.print("No unambiguous charge result arrived for item " .. tostring(pending.id) .. "; its charges are now unknown.", "red") if result and result.ok then gbr.switchFrom(pending.id, "unknown charge count") end end
function gbr.sendBrandish(item) local stateResult = DINV.api.getStaveChargeState(item.id, { source = "live" }) if not stateResult or not stateResult.ok or not stateResult.state then gbr.print("Cannot read the selected stave's charge state.", "red") return false end local state = stateResult.state local reservation = DINV.actions.reserveStaveUse(item.id, { floor = gbr.config.chargeFloor, expectedRevision = state.revision, }) if not reservation or not reservation.ok then gbr.print("Brandish blocked: " .. tostring(reservation and (reservation.message or reservation.code) or "charge reservation failed"), "orange_red") return false end
gbr.runtime.pendingUse = { id = tostring(item.id), token = reservation.state.reservationToken, revision = reservation.state.revision, name = normalized(itemName(item)), startedAt = os.time(), } if not sendCommand("brandish") then DINV.actions.cancelStaveUse(item.id, reservation.state.reservationToken, { markUnknown = false }) gbr.runtime.pendingUse = nil return false end after(gbr.config.resultTimeout, "resultTimeout", gbr.handleMissingResult) return true end
function gbr.attemptBrandish(manual) manual = manual == true if not manual and not gbr.config.enabled then return end if not gbr.inCombat() then if manual then gbr.print("Manual brandish is guarded and only runs in combat.", "orange_red") end return end if not gbr.dinvReady() then gbr.print("DINV API v3 is required. Reload the updated DINV package first.", "red") return end if gbr.runtime.pendingUse or gbr.runtime.switching then return end
if not gbr.roomSnapshotReady() then gbr.requestRoomSnapshot(manual) return end local snapshot = gbr.runtime.roomSnapshot local safe, unsafe = gbr.roomSafety(snapshot) if not safe then if manual then gbr.print("Brandish blocked by room safety: " .. table.concat(unsafe, ", "), "red") end gbr.scheduleAuto(gbr.config.interval) return end if number(snapshot.npcCount, 0) < 1 then if manual then gbr.print("Brandish blocked: no NPCs are visible in roomchars.", "orange_red") end gbr.scheduleAuto(gbr.config.interval) return end if not manual and number(snapshot.npcCount, 0) < gbr.config.aoe then gbr.scheduleAuto(gbr.config.interval) return end
local current = gbr.currentStave() local currentKnown, currentDirty, currentCharges = chargeState(current) if current and currentKnown and not currentDirty and currentCharges and currentCharges > gbr.config.chargeFloor then gbr.runtime.activeId = tostring(current.id) gbr.sendBrandish(current) return end
local usable, err = gbr.findUsableStaves(current and current.id) if not usable then gbr.print(err, "red") return end if #usable == 0 then gbr.print("No identified matching stave has more than one charge. Auto mode stopped.", "red") gbr.config.enabled = false gbr.saveSettings() return end gbr.equipStave(usable[1], function(ok, message) if not ok then gbr.print("Could not equip replacement stave: " .. tostring(message), "red") return end if manual then after(0.15, "tick", function() gbr.attemptBrandish(true) end) else gbr.scheduleAuto(0.15) end end) end
function gbr.switchFrom(depletedId, reason) if gbr.runtime.switching then return end local usable, err = gbr.findUsableStaves(depletedId) if not usable then gbr.print(err, "red"); return end if #usable == 0 then DINV.actions.remove(depletedId, { label = "GBrandish retire depleted stave" }) gbr.runtime.activeId = nil gbr.config.enabled = false gbr.saveSettings() gbr.print("No replacement stave is ready after " .. tostring(reason) .. "; the depleted stave was removed and auto mode stopped.", "red") return end gbr.equipStave(usable[1], function(ok, message) if ok then local _, _, charges = chargeState(usable[1]) gbr.print(string.format("Switched to %s (id %s, %s charges).", stripColors(itemName(usable[1])), tostring(usable[1].id), tostring(charges)), "green") gbr.scheduleAuto(gbr.config.interval) else gbr.config.enabled = false gbr.saveSettings() gbr.print("Replacement switch failed: " .. tostring(message) .. ". Auto mode stopped.", "red") end end) end
function gbr.onChargeLine(name, charges) local pending = gbr.runtime.pendingUse if not pending then return end local outputName = normalized(name) if outputName ~= pending.name then gbr.debug("Ignored charge line for " .. outputName .. "; pending " .. pending.name) return end local count = tonumber(charges) if not count then return end
killTimerField("resultTimeout") gbr.runtime.pendingUse = nil local result = DINV.actions.observeStaveCharges(pending.id, count, { source = "brandish-confirmation", expectedRevision = pending.revision, }) if not result or not result.ok then DINV.actions.markStaveChargesUnknown(pending.id, { source = "rejected-brandish-confirmation" }) gbr.print("DINV rejected the charge confirmation for item " .. pending.id .. ".", "red") return end
gbr.invalidateRoom("brandish completed") if count <= gbr.config.chargeFloor then -- The server has confirmed the last safe use. Switch now, before any -- future request can encounter a one-charge stave. gbr.switchFrom(pending.id, tostring(count) .. " charge remaining") else gbr.scheduleAuto(gbr.config.interval) end end
function gbr.onStatus() local nowCombat = gbr.inCombat() local wasCombat = gbr.runtime.inCombat == true gbr.runtime.inCombat = nowCombat if nowCombat and not wasCombat and gbr.config.enabled then gbr.invalidateRoom("combat started") gbr.scheduleAuto(0.5) elseif not nowCombat and wasCombat then killTimerField("tick") gbr.runtime.manualQueued = false end end
function gbr.onRoomInfo() gbr.invalidateRoom("GMCP room changed") end
function gbr.onPopulationChange() if gbr.inCombat() then gbr.invalidateRoom("room population changed") end end
function gbr.refresh() local staves, err = gbr.getStaves(true) if not staves then gbr.print(err, "red"); return end local ids = {} for _, item in ipairs(staves) do table.insert(ids, tostring(item.id)) end if #ids == 0 then gbr.print("No staves match selector '" .. gbr.config.selector .. "'.", "orange_red") return end local result = DINV.actions.identify(ids, { source = "GBrandish refresh" }) if result and result.ok then gbr.print(string.format("Queued %d matching stave(s) for forced DINV identification.", result.count), "green") if #(result.rejected or {}) > 0 then gbr.print(string.format("%d stave(s) were not queued; use gbr refresh again after DINV is idle.", #(result.rejected or {})), "orange_red") end else gbr.print("Refresh failed: " .. tostring(result and (result.message or result.code) or "unknown error"), "red") end end
function gbr.resync() local current = gbr.currentStave() if not current then gbr.print("No matching held/active stave is known to DINV.", "orange_red") return end local result = DINV.actions.identify(current.id, { source = "GBrandish resync" }) if result and result.ok then gbr.print("Queued item " .. tostring(current.id) .. " for authoritative identification.", "green") else gbr.print("Resync failed: " .. tostring(result and (result.message or result.code) or "unknown error"), "red") end end
local function oneChargeTargets() local staves, err = gbr.getStaves(false) if not staves then return nil, err end local targets = {} for _, item in ipairs(staves) do local known, dirty, charges = chargeState(item) if known and not dirty and charges == gbr.config.chargeFloor and not itemIsKept(item) then table.insert(targets, item) end end table.sort(targets, function(a, b) return tostring(a.id) < tostring(b.id) end) return targets end
local function verifyTopInventory(ids) local ready, missing = {}, {} for _, id in ipairs(ids) do local result = DINV.api.getItem(id, { detail = "full", source = "live" }) local item = result and result.ok and result.item or nil if item and normalized(item.location) == "inventory" and not item.isWorn then table.insert(ready, id) else table.insert(missing, id) end end return ready, missing end
function gbr.collect(callback) callback = callback or function() end if not gbr.dinvReady() then gbr.print("DINV API v3 is not ready.", "red"); callback({}); return end local targets, err = oneChargeTargets() if not targets then gbr.print(err, "red"); callback({}); return end if #targets == 0 then gbr.print("No known, unkept one-charge staves need collecting.", "cyan") callback({}) return end
local ids, wornIds = {}, {} for _, item in ipairs(targets) do table.insert(ids, tostring(item.id)) if item.isWorn or itemIsHeld(item) then table.insert(wornIds, tostring(item.id)) end end
local function retrieve() local result = DINV.actions.retrieve(ids, { label = "GBrandish collect", report = false, onFinish = function() local ready, missing = verifyTopInventory(ids) gbr.print(string.format("Collected %d/%d one-charge stave(s) into inventory.", #ready, #ids), #missing == 0 and "green" or "orange_red") if #missing > 0 then gbr.print("Unconfirmed ids: " .. table.concat(missing, ", "), "orange_red") end callback(ready, missing) end, }) if not result or not result.ok then gbr.print("Collect failed: " .. tostring(result and (result.message or result.code) or "unknown error"), "red") callback({}) elseif number(result.commandCount, 0) == 0 then local ready, missing = verifyTopInventory(ids) gbr.print(string.format("%d/%d one-charge stave(s) are already in inventory.", #ready, #ids), #missing == 0 and "green" or "orange_red") callback(ready, missing) end end
if #wornIds > 0 then local removeResult = DINV.actions.remove(wornIds, { label = "GBrandish remove depleted", report = false, onFinish = retrieve, }) if not removeResult or not removeResult.ok then gbr.print("Could not remove a depleted stave before collecting.", "red") callback({}) elseif number(removeResult.commandCount, 0) == 0 then retrieve() end else retrieve() end end
function gbr.sell() if gbr.inCombat() then gbr.print("gbr sell is disabled in combat.", "red") return end gbr.collect(function(ids) if #ids == 0 then return end for _, id in ipairs(ids) do sendCommand("sell " .. id) end local started = os.time() local function verifySales() local sold, remaining = {}, {} for _, id in ipairs(ids) do local result = DINV.api.getItem(id, { source = "live" }) if not result or not result.ok then table.insert(sold, id) else table.insert(remaining, id) end end if #remaining > 0 and os.time() - started < 7 then after(0.5, "sellVerify", verifySales) return end gbr.print(string.format("Sold %d/%d exact one-charge stave id(s).", #sold, #ids), #remaining == 0 and "green" or "orange_red") if #remaining > 0 then gbr.print("Not confirmed sold: " .. table.concat(remaining, ", "), "orange_red") end end after(0.5, "sellVerify", verifySales) end) end
function gbr.status() local staves, err = gbr.getStaves(true) local known, usable, depleted, unknown = 0, 0, 0, 0 if staves then for _, item in ipairs(staves) do local isKnown, dirty, charges = chargeState(item) if not isKnown or dirty then unknown = unknown + 1 else known = known + 1 if charges > gbr.config.chargeFloor then usable = usable + 1 elseif charges == gbr.config.chargeFloor then depleted = depleted + 1 end end end end local current = staves and gbr.currentStave() or nil local _, _, currentCharges = chargeState(current) local snapshot = gbr.runtime.roomSnapshot local safe, unsafe = gbr.roomSafety(snapshot) gbr.print(string.format("%s | selector='%s' | aoe >= %d NPC | interval %.1fs", gbr.config.enabled and "ON" or "OFF", gbr.config.selector, gbr.config.aoe, gbr.config.interval), gbr.config.enabled and "green" or "cyan") if err then gbr.print(err, "red") return end gbr.print(string.format("pool: %d matching, %d known, %d usable, %d at one, %d unknown", #(staves or {}), known, usable, depleted, unknown), "cyan") gbr.print(string.format("active: %s | id %s | charges %s | pending %s", current and stripColors(itemName(current)) or "none", current and tostring(current.id) or "-", currentCharges and tostring(currentCharges) or "unknown", gbr.runtime.pendingUse and "yes" or "no"), "cyan") gbr.print(string.format("roomchars: %s | NPC %s | players %d | safety %s%s", gbr.roomSnapshotReady() and "fresh" or "dirty/missing", snapshot and tostring(snapshot.npcCount) or "?", snapshot and #(snapshot.players or {}) or 0, safe and "safe" or "blocked", not safe and (" (" .. table.concat(unsafe, ", ") .. ")") or ""), safe and "green" or "orange_red") end
function gbr.help() gbr.print("Commands:", "cyan") gbr.print(" gbr on|off enable or disable automatic guarded brandish", "white") gbr.print(" gbr <name> set the stave selector (example: gbr breath)", "white") gbr.print(" gbr aoe <number> require at least this many NPC roomchars", "white") gbr.print(" gbr interval <seconds> set confirmed-use cadence (minimum 0.5)", "white") gbr.print(" gbr brandish guarded one-shot; bypasses only the AOE threshold", "white") gbr.print(" gbr status show pool, active charge, and room safety state", "white") gbr.print(" gbr resync force-identify the active/held matching stave", "white") gbr.print(" gbr refresh force-identify every matching stave", "white") gbr.print(" gbr collect retrieve all known unkept one-charge staves", "white") gbr.print(" gbr sell collect then sell those exact ids (not in combat)", "white") end
function gbr.command(arguments) local line = trim(arguments) local command, rest = line:match("^(%S+)%s*(.-)$") command = normalized(command) rest = trim(rest) if command == "" or command == "help" then gbr.help(); return end if command == "on" then gbr.config.enabled = true gbr.saveSettings() gbr.print("Automatic brandish enabled.", "green") if gbr.inCombat() then gbr.invalidateRoom("auto enabled"); gbr.scheduleAuto(0.5) end elseif command == "off" then gbr.config.enabled = false gbr.saveSettings() killTimerField("tick") gbr.print("Automatic brandish disabled.", "cyan") elseif command == "aoe" then local value = tonumber(rest) if not value or value < 1 then gbr.print("Usage: gbr aoe <number >= 1>", "orange_red"); return end gbr.config.aoe = math.floor(value) gbr.saveSettings() gbr.print("AOE threshold set to " .. tostring(gbr.config.aoe) .. " NPC(s).", "green") elseif command == "interval" then local value = tonumber(rest) if not value or value < 0.5 then gbr.print("Usage: gbr interval <seconds >= 0.5>", "orange_red"); return end gbr.config.interval = value gbr.saveSettings() gbr.print(string.format("Brandish interval set to %.1f seconds.", value), "green") elseif command == "brandish" then gbr.attemptBrandish(true) elseif command == "status" then gbr.status() elseif command == "resync" then gbr.resync() elseif command == "refresh" then gbr.refresh() elseif command == "collect" then gbr.collect() elseif command == "sell" then gbr.sell() elseif command == "debug" then gbr.config.debug = normalized(rest) == "on" gbr.print("Debug " .. (gbr.config.debug and "enabled" or "disabled") .. ".", "cyan") elseif command == "set" then if rest == "" then gbr.print("Usage: gbr set <stave name>", "orange_red"); return end gbr.config.selector = rest gbr.saveSettings() gbr.runtime.activeId = nil gbr.print("Stave selector set to '" .. rest .. "'.", "green") else -- The compact form requested by the user: `gbr breath` selects the -- matching stave pool without adding a separate attack command. gbr.config.selector = line gbr.saveSettings() gbr.runtime.activeId = nil gbr.print("Stave selector set to '" .. line .. "'.", "green") end end
function gbr.shutdownRuntime() local timerNames = {} for name in pairs(gbr.timers or {}) do table.insert(timerNames, name) end for _, name in ipairs(timerNames) do killTimerField(name) end for _, id in pairs(gbr.triggers or {}) do if id and type(killTrigger) == "function" then pcall(killTrigger, id) end end for _, id in pairs(gbr.aliases or {}) do if id and type(killAlias) == "function" then pcall(killAlias, id) end end for _, id in pairs(gbr.handlers or {}) do if id and type(killAnonymousEventHandler) == "function" then pcall(killAnonymousEventHandler, id) end end gbr.triggers, gbr.aliases, gbr.handlers, gbr.timers = {}, {}, {}, {} end
function gbr.installRuntime() gbr.shutdownRuntime() gbr.loadSettings() gbr.runtime = { inCombat = gbr.inCombat(), roomDirty = true, }
gbr.triggers.charge = tempRegexTrigger("^(.+?) has (\\d+) charges? remaining\\.$", function() if matches then gbr.onChargeLine(matches[2], matches[3]) end end) gbr.triggers.roomStart = tempRegexTrigger("^\\{roomchars\\}$", gbr.roomcharsStart) gbr.triggers.roomEnd = tempRegexTrigger("^\\{/roomchars\\}$", gbr.roomcharsEnd) gbr.triggers.roomLine = tempRegexTrigger("^(.*)$", function() if gbr.runtime.roomCapture and matches then gbr.roomcharsLine(matches[2]) end end) gbr.triggers.population = tempRegexTrigger( "(?i)\\b(arrives|enters|leaves|has arrived|fades into existence)\\b", gbr.onPopulationChange)
gbr.handlers.status = registerAnonymousEventHandler("gmcp.char.status", gbr.onStatus) gbr.handlers.room = registerAnonymousEventHandler("gmcp.room.info", gbr.onRoomInfo) gbr.handlers.group = registerAnonymousEventHandler("gmcp.group", function() end)
if type(sendGMCP) == "function" then pcall(sendGMCP, "group on") after(0.6, "groupRequest", function() pcall(sendGMCP, "request group") end) end sendCommand("tags roomchars on") gbr.print("Loaded v" .. gbr.version .. ". Use 'gbr status' or 'gbr help'.", "green") if gbr.config.enabled and gbr.inCombat() then gbr.scheduleAuto(0.5) end end
gbr.installRuntime()
